scenes.summary: Late at night Harker broods on the last earth-box and his faith in Mina. Woken by Mina alarmed at a sound in the corridor, he finds Morris on guard outside, and Mina falls back asleep comforted by brave men.

scenes.title: Call for Hypnosis Before Dawn
scenes.summary: Before dawn Mina urgently calls for Van Helsing to hypnotize her. He arrives in dressing-gown with the others gathering, fixes her gaze, and brings her into trance as daylight approaches.

muse_override.reason: Urgent pre-dawn hypnosis creates tense suspense with mysterious trance atmosphere.

scenes.title: Voices on the Water
scenes.summary: Under hypnosis Mina answers she sees darkness but hears lapping water, stamping men, and capstan chain. Van Helsing and the watchers realize she is on a ship, until sunrise breaks the trance and she awakes asking what she said.

scenes.title: Flight by Sea and a Dread Purpose
scenes.summary: Van Helsing explains Dracula has taken his last box aboard ship to flee London. When Mina asks why pursue him, he solemnly says because his mark is on her throat and time is dreaded, and she faints at the horror.

scenes.title: Van Helsing's Orders
scenes.summary: Van Helsing leaves a phonograph message ordering Jonathan to stay and guard Mina, revealing the Count has fled back to Transylvania and promising the fight has only begun.

muse_override.reason: Reassuring orders amid urgent pursuit blend suspense and adventure with calm resolve.

scenes.title: Fragile Comfort
scenes.summary: Jonathan reads the message to Mina and feels brief comfort in daylight, but Mina's scar and their re-reading of the diaries keep fear alive beneath a fragile hope.

scenes.title: Tracing the Czarina Catherine
scenes.summary: At the evening report meeting, Van Helsing recounts how, certain Dracula would flee by the Black Sea for the Danube, they checked Lloyd's and found only one Black-Sea-bound ship on the tide, the Czarina Catherine for Varna, and then questioned men at Doolittle's Wharf.

muse_override.reason: Methodical hunt identifies the Count's ship, blending suspenseful deduction with adventurous pursuit.

scenes.title: The Thin Man and the Fog
scenes.summary: The wharf men describe a hurrying tall, thin, pale man in black who paid the captain well, himself loaded a great box aboard, and returned at full tide; a dense fog held only around the ship until he boarded, then lifted and the Czarina Catherine sailed on the ebb.

scenes.title: The Plan for Varna
scenes.summary: Van Helsing concludes the Count is at sea with fog at his command for the Danube mouth, but they can travel faster by land to meet him; the box is consigned to agent Ristics at Varna, and they must strike while he lies helpless in the box between sunrise and sunset.

scenes.title: Necessary Pursuit
scenes.summary: Mina questions pursuing the Count, and Van Helsing erupts in passionate resolve, warning that her infection means she will become like him unless they act, and that the tiger man-eater will never stop.

muse_override.reason: Van Helsing's passionate plea for a righteous hunt creates tense, resolute suspense.

scenes.title: Peace Shattered
scenes.summary: The council adjourns to sleep on a plan; Mina feels momentary peace until she sees her red forehead mark in the mirror and knows she is still unclean.

muse_override.reason: False peace shatters into dread when mirror reveals the unclean mark.

scenes.title: Morning Cheer and Shared Fear
scenes.summary: Seward notes forced cheerfulness at early breakfast, broken only by the scar on Mina's forehead. He confides his dread that her tongue is tied by the Count's poison, and alone with Van Helsing learns the Professor shares his fear that Mina is changing and that the Count may compel her to reveal their plans.

scenes.title: The Painful Resolve to Exclude Her
scenes.summary: Van Helsing resolves that Mina must be kept ignorant of their intent and excluded from their council lest the Count read her mind. Seward agrees to spare him doubt, and Van Helsing withdraws to prepare himself for the painful task.

scenes.title: Plan of Campaign
scenes.summary: Relieved by Mina's absence, the men plan to reach Varna before the ship, arm with Winchesters, and pointedly exclude Harker to guard his wife, silencing disclosure with a finger to lips.

scenes.title: Watching Mina Sleep
scenes.summary: Jonathan is left dazed after the morning meeting, puzzled by Mina's determination to withdraw, and watches her sleeping calmly and happily like a child.

scenes.title: The Holy Promise
scenes.summary: Mina wakes and makes Jonathan swear holily never to tell her the plans against the Count while the scar remains, shutting a door between them, before a strangely bright and gay evening.

muse_override.reason: Solemn tender oath and scarred foreboding blend quiet calm with deep sadness and looming dread.

scenes.title: Mina Must Go
scenes.summary: At sunrise Mina summons Van Helsing to declare she must go with them, for the Count can summon her and she can serve them through hypnosis; he accepts her wisdom.

scenes.title: Ready for Varna
scenes.summary: The men resolve to board the ship at Varna, rose-branch the box and destroy the Count, settle wills and travel, as sunset brings Mina's uneasiness and Jonathan is called away.

scenes.title: Sunset Freedom Gathering
scenes.summary: Seward records for Harker as the group gathers before sunset, when Mina regains her free self after a struggle, and draws everyone close to speak.

muse_override.reason: Tense intimate gathering awaiting Mina's sunset freedom blends suspense and mystery with quiet sorrow.

scenes.title: The Dreadful Vow
scenes.summary: Mina solemnly asks all, even her husband, to promise to kill her with stake and beheading if she turns, and warns they must act instantly as she may then be leagued with the enemy.

scenes.title: Burial Service Reading
scenes.summary: Mina asks Jonathan to read the Burial Service over her; he reads brokenly amid kneeling friends, bringing strange comfort as her freedom fades.

scenes.title: Watch at Varna
scenes.summary: The party races to Varna on the Orient Express to await the Czarina Catherine; hypnotic reports show only sea and wind, and they plan to board her by day and destroy the Count.

scenes.title: Ship Reported, Fevered Wait
scenes.summary: News that the ship passed the Dardanelles sparks battle excitement; they retire to rise ready, while Seward notes Mina's lethargy and sharpening danger.

scenes.title: Lethargy and Mounting Fear
scenes.summary: The ship fails to arrive and Mina sinks into troubling lethargy; Van Helsing fears souls can act strangely in trance and plans a fuller sunset questioning.

scenes.title: Diverted to Galatz
scenes.summary: A telegram reveals the ship has bypassed them for Galatz; after stunned reactions, Mina supplies train times and Van Helsing dispatches the men to prepare pursuit.

scenes.title: The Count's Escape Trick
scenes.summary: Alone with Seward, Van Helsing theorizes the Count read Mina's mind in trance, learned they were in Varna, fled to Galatz, and cut her off, believing himself free.

scenes.title: Child-Brain and Hope
scenes.summary: From Harker's journal Van Helsing expounds the Count's child-criminal habit of repeating past flight; Mina sees her soul is freer, yet can still track him at sunrise and sunset.

muse_override.reason: Van Helsing's criminal child-brain deduction turns fear into hopeful clarity with suspenseful revelation.

scenes.title: Sunset Trance on the Train
scenes.summary: On the night train to Galatz the party gathers at sunset for Mina's hypnosis. With unusual difficulty she reports still water, voices, oars, a gun, tramping feet and blowing air, then wakes asking sweetly for tea while the men grasp its ominous meaning.

muse_override.reason: Hypnotic trance report builds mystery and suspense with eerie harbor sounds, then softens with tea.

scenes.title: Counsel and a Fruitless Dawn
scenes.summary: Van Helsing explains the Count is close to land but not yet ashore, vulnerable by day if still boxed. At dawn Mina can say only that all is dark with lapping water and creaking wood, and the party rushes toward Galatz in agony, already hours late.

scenes.title: The Fading Power
scenes.summary: At sunset Mina resists hypnosis and speaks enigmatically of cold wind, strange tongues, falling water and wolves, then shakes in palsy. Next morning she fails completely, remembering nothing after sunrise, as the train nears Galatz in feverish anxiety.

scenes.title: Arrival in Galatz
scenes.summary: Arrived in Galatz, the forces divide: Morris sees Mina to the hotel, Godalming seeks the Vice-Consul, Jonathan and the doctors go to the shipping agent. The officials are absent or sick, leaving only a clerk's willing but thin help.

scenes.title: The Captain's Tale
scenes.summary: Aboard the Czarina Catherine, Captain Donelson tells of an uncannily swift, fog-bound voyage from London, grumbling Romanian sailors, and a great box marked Galatz via Varna taken before sunrise by a man with English papers, receipt signed Immanuel Hildesheim.

scenes.title: Dead End at Skinsky's Murder
scenes.summary: Hildesheim admits clearing the box before sunrise for Skinsky, dealer with the Slovaks. Skinsky has vanished, then is found murdered in St. Peter's churchyard with his throat torn open. The box is somewhere on the water, and the party returns heavy-hearted to consider trusting Mina again.

muse_override.reason: Frustrated inquiry turns to horror at Skinsky's savaged body, leaving heavy-hearted suspense and mystery.

scenes.title: Mina Types While the Men Rest
scenes.summary: Mina asks the exhausted, dispirited men to rest for half an hour while she types up everything, grateful for the Traveller's typewriter, as she watches Jonathan collapsed in pain on the sofa and resolves to help him.

scenes.title: Mina Makes Her Discovery
scenes.summary: Mina gets the remaining papers from Van Helsing and studies them without prejudice while the men rest, finds a discovery confirmed by the maps, and prepares her memorandum to lay before the party.

muse_override.reason: Mina's calm, methodical review builds suspense toward a hopeful mysterious breakthrough.

scenes.title: By Road, by Rail, by Water
scenes.summary: Mina reasons the Count, confined helpless in his box between dawn and sunset, must be carried by someone, and by exclusion rejects road for curiosity, customs, and pursuit and rail for delay without a keeper, leaving water as safest despite its danger, so they must ascertain what water.

muse_override.reason: Cold logical elimination of escape routes builds tense suspense laced with mystery.

scenes.title: The River Route to the Castle
scenes.summary: Mina traces his feint invoice to Varna, swift run of the Czarina Catherine to Galatz, and handover through Hildesheim to Skinsky, argues Skinsky was chosen for isolated Slovak river carriage and then murdered, and from map and trance sounds of water and creaking wood concludes the box is in an open boat poled upstream, likely the Sereth to the Bistritza toward the Borgo Pass.

scenes.title: Council of War
scenes.summary: Hailed as teacher for her hypnotic clue, Mina's plan becomes a council of war: Godalming by steam launch upriver, Morris and Seward on horseback along the bank, Van Helsing with Mina overland to the Castle. Jonathan protests hotly at taking Mina toward Dracula, and Van Helsing calms him by arguing only destroying the Count and sanctifying his nest can save her.

scenes.title: Hasty Arming and Farewell
scenes.summary: Jonathan yields to God's hands while Mina records their hasty equipping with Godalming's and Morris's money: steam launch, horses, maps, arms and furs, and Van Helsing's night train to Veresti for the Borgo. She ends with a fearful, tearless goodbye to Jonathan.

scenes.title: Pursuit by Steam Launch
scenes.summary: By furnace-light Jonathan and Godalming race up the Sereth into the Bistritza, overhauling boats under a Romanian flag, learning a double-crewed boat passed before Fundu. Cold, sleeplessness and engine strain wear them as they push toward Strasba hoping to join the horsemen.

scenes.title: Hard Riding on the Bank
scenes.summary: Three hard days on horseback, Seward and Morris press after the launch, hearing at Fundu it went up the Bistritza and was delayed forcing the rapids. With snow threatening, they push harder, knowing their help may soon be needed.

scenes.title: Veresti - Into the Enemy's Country
scenes.summary: Mina and Van Helsing reach Veresti, where hypnosis yields only dark and quiet. They buy carriage, horses, furs and provisions for the 70-mile drive to the Borgo Pass, commending Jonathan to God as they prepare to start into the enemy's country.

scenes.title: Kind Horses and the Evil Eye
scenes.summary: Mina records a rapid eastward drive with willing horses and generous peasants. After a serving woman reacts to the scar on her forehead as the evil eye, she hides it beneath hat and veil, while the tireless Van Helsing hurries toward Bistritz and his sunset hypnosis confirms Dracula is still on the river.

scenes.title: The Wild Road to the Borgo Pass
scenes.summary: Mina and Van Helsing take turns driving through cold and oppressive air into wilder Carpathian country. Morning hypnosis suggests the river is changing as Dracula ascends, and with a rude four-in-hand they press on to reach the Borgo Pass by daylight, cheering each other while Mina prays for guidance and for Jonathan.

muse_override.reason: Cold daylight drive into towering Carpathians mixes oppressive dread with urgent forward journey toward the Pass.

scenes.title: Cold Record and Jonathan's Byroad
scenes.summary: Van Helsing takes up the record in bitter cold at the Borgo Pass, noting Mina has slept all day, lost appetite, and made no diary entry. At dawn she briefly yields to hypnosis with only darkness and swirling water, then shows strange zeal to find Jonathan's byroad. She sleeps on through the long climb until he cannot wake her.

scenes.title: Failing Trance by the Night Fire
scenes.summary: At sunset Van Helsing rouses Mina but fails altogether to hypnotize her. By the night fire she seems bright and well, yet eats apart from him, and his watch keeps lapsing into sleep. By morning hypnosis fails again and she sinks into a heavy, unnatural sleep that leaves him fearing the vampire taint is growing.

scenes.title: The Holy Circle Before the Castle
scenes.summary: Pushing through wild precipices toward the castle hill, Van Helsing finds Mina unwakeable. At twilight before the castle he feeds the horses, makes fire, and draws a Holy circle with the Wafer around her. She cannot cross it, proving her soul still safe though her body is in danger.

scenes.title: Night Siege by the Sisters
scenes.summary: Through the snow-mist night the three female vampires materialize outside the ring, calling Mina sister. Van Helsing holds them off with fire and Wafer while horses cower and Mina smiles strangely. At dawn they melt toward the castle and he finds Mina in deep sleep and the horses dead.

scenes.title: Pursuers Converging
scenes.summary: After the night of terror, Jonathan records pursuit on horseback after the launch failure, and Seward records sighting the Szgany leiter-wagon fleeing the river in light snow with wolves howling. All parties are riding to a final convergence.

scenes.title: Entering the Chapel and Sealing Dracula's Tomb
scenes.summary: Leaving Mina asleep in the Holy circle, Van Helsing breaks into the castle and finds his way to the chapel. Oppressed by fumes and tempted by the voluptuous beauty of the three vampire women in their tombs, he is roused by Mina's distant wail, locates all three sisters and Dracula's great tomb, which he seals with Wafer to banish the Count forever.

scenes.title: Destroying the Sisters and Returning to Mina
scenes.summary: Nerved by Mina's cry, Van Helsing stakes and beheads the three vampire sisters, watching their bodies dissolve to native dust. He then bars the castle entrances against the Count's return and goes back to Mina, who wakes to see what he has endured.

muse_override.reason: Grisly butchery remembered with trembling pity and relief tilts to sorrow with combat horror underneath.

scenes.title: Watch on the Snowy Waste
scenes.summary: Cured of ruddy vampire sleep but weak, Mina goes east with Van Helsing to meet her husband. From a rock hollow sheltered by a new circle they spot the cart with the great chest, pursued from south and north by Seward, Morris, Jonathan and Godalming, while wolves gather as sunset nears.

scenes.title: Halt: The Rush for the Cart
scenes.summary: Surrounded by rifles, the gypsies halt but draw weapons and ring the cart. Jonathan and Quincey force their way through knives to the cart, hurl the great box to the ground, Morris wounded in the side, and together prize off the lid.

scenes.title: Sunset: Dracula Crumbles to Dust
scenes.summary: Dracula lies pale in the box with vindictive eyes turning triumphant at the sinking sun. At sunset Jonathan shears through his throat as Morris plunges his bowie into his heart, and the body crumbles to dust with a look of peace.

muse_override.reason: Violent final strike dissolves into miraculous dust and unexpected peaceful relief.

scenes.title: Release and a Gallant Death
scenes.summary: The castle stands against the red sky as gypsies flee and wolves follow them. Mortally wounded in the side, Morris declares himself happy, points to Mina's forehead now stainless in the sunset light as proof the curse is lifted, receives their Amen, and dies smiling.

scenes.title: Seven Years After - Peace and Remembrance
scenes.summary: Seven years after the events, Jonathan Harker reflects with peaceful, nostalgic joy. He notes his son Quincey, named for Quincey Morris, recounts a return pilgrimage to a now-empty Transylvania, and describes re-reading their collected papers at home with friends, closing with Van Helsing's tribute to Mina's bravery.

muse_override.reason: Peaceful nostalgic closure mixing domestic happiness with tender remembrance of sacrifice.
